announcer_intro.text: Welcome to the grid. The track is set, the cars are ready, and the wait is almost over!

announcer_intro_time_trial.text: One car, one clear track. Time to chase the perfect lap!

announcer_start.text: Lights out, and away we go!

announcer_lead_change.text: We have a new race leader!

announcer_player_overtake.text: Great move! You have made the pass!

announcer_player_overtaken.text: A rival slips through. Time to fight back!

announcer_fastest_lap.text: That is the fastest lap of the race!

announcer_off_track.text: A trip off the track. Keep it tidy!

announcer_last_lap.text: The final lap. Everything to play for!

announcer_winner.text: The winner takes the flag! What a drive!

announcer_finish_p1.text: You win! A brilliant drive from start to finish!

announcer_finish_p2.text: Second place! A fantastic podium finish!

announcer_finish_p3.text: Third place! You are on the podium!

announcer_finish_points.text: A strong race. Points in the bag!

announcer_finish.text: That is the flag. Great effort out there!

radio_start.text: Radio check. Nice and clean into turn one.

radio_box_box.text: Box box. Pit this lap. Your tyres need changing.

radio_tyre_warning.text: Tyre wear is climbing. Be smooth with the steering.

radio_tyre_critical.text: Tyres are critical. We need to box soon.

radio_wet_weather.text: Rain is here. We should switch to wet tyres.

radio_dry_weather.text: The track is drying. Dry tyres are the call.

radio_push.text: You have a gap. Push now, but keep it clean.

radio_pit_confirmed.text: Pit confirmed. Entry is on your left.

radio_pit_complete.text: Fresh tyres on. Good stop. push when you are ready.
